 STOP[\"Second EC2 terminal: --stop web-demo\"] --> CHECK[\"Verify recorded runtime owner\"]
 CHECK --> PARENT[\"Host Capsule parent receives SIGTERM\"]
 TERMINAL[\"Ctrl+C or a direct signal to the parent\"] --> PARENT
 PARENT --> INIT[\"Container PID 1 receives the signal\"]
 INIT --> GROUP[\"Forward to workload process group\"]
 GROUP --> APP[\"Application handles shutdown\"]
 GROUP --> CHILDREN[\"Ordinary application children receive the signal\"]
 APP --> WAIT[\"PID 1 reaps workload and exits\"]
 WAIT --> CLEAN[\"Parent waits, cleans resources, saves stopped\"]

 classDef process fill:#e1d5e7,stroke:#9673a6
 classDef success fill:#d5e8d4,stroke:#82b366
 class STOP,CHECK,TERMINAL,GROUP,WAIT action
 class PARENT,INIT,APP,CHILDREN process
 class CLEAN success",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
